en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5504 - Al-Qasim Muhammad Al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), about a freed woman whom my brother had emancipated. She used to serve the maidservants and was living among his family. He had instructed me to spend on her moderately.
Abu Jafar (as), said: "If she remained with the maidservants and continued serving them, then spend on her and follow his will."
